C0269.title: SPP Releases Typical Case on Manufacturing and Selling Counterfeit Goods: Pan et al. Producing and Selling Substandard Fire Extinguishers
C0269.summary: From March to July 2023, Pan and others borrowed another party's 3C certificate to organize the production of 'Sansheng' brand dry powder fire extinguishers with substandard wall thickness and unqualified extinguishing agent.
